title: bug: heartbeatStop.test.ts "does not re-exec and lose a pending Bash sidecar handle" fails on HEAD 091c7dd0: wrapper_pin_drop command not found (exit 127)
description: Found by task-8c40a8fe's full daemon snapshot gate. A pure `git archive 091c7dd0` (no overlay), `npx vitest run src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts` -> 1 failed | 5 passed | 3 skipped. Output: "wrapper source changed on disk; restarting to load it", "bash: line 41: wrapper_pin_drop: command not found", exit 127 (expected 0). Likely from 373dc3d4 (hot-reload check-to-exec race): moe-agent.sh:240 calls wrapper_pin_drop (defined :8793) in a path the test's extracted fragment reaches without the function defined. Fix test fixture or wrapper guard. Full suite otherwise 227/228 files, 6880 passed.

implementationPlan.description:
RED, then the fixture fix. This is a test-only change: the whole diff is two inserted lines in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts. Nothing else changes: not the wrapper, not the assertions, not the slice anchors and not the other cases.

RED first (test-driven-development): before editing, run the step-2 command once. Its Linux leg must fail on 'does not re-exec and lose a pending Bash sidecar handle' with 'bash: line 41: wrapper_pin_drop: command not found', exit 127. Quote that in complete_step. The PowerShell twin's RED comes from step 3's stub-removal mutant on Windows. Planning evidence for both is in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f6d9c532-plan/ (README.md, f6d9-win-head.log).

The edit. Use an editor tool (Edit on a Claude seat, apply_patch on a Codex seat), not a shell write. The file is LF (eol=lf) and must stay LF.
1. In the bash case's fixture, directly after the line `wrapper_reload_deferred() { return 1; }`, add: `wrapper_pin_drop() { MOE_WRAPPER_PIN=''; }`
2. In the PowerShell case's fixture, directly after `function Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred { param($Hash) $false }`, add: `function Remove-MoeWrapperPin { $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin = $null }`
Both lines sit inside JS template literals. Neither contains `${`, so nothing is interpolated.

Why the fixture and not a wrapper guard (the governor's 22:59Z comment asks the planner to say why):
- Precedent: 46340ec2 (task-cf7f4708) fixed the same class of break, when the reload body gained Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred, by stubbing it in this fixture. The fixture already stubs every helper the extracted body calls: sha256sum, wrapper_reload_deferred, stop_heartbeat_sidecar and exec; Get-MoeSha256Hex, Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred, Stop-HeartbeatSidecar and Invoke-MoeDeregister.
- In the real wrapper, both helpers are always defined before the loop runs: wrapper_pin_drop at moe-agent.sh:8793, before the loop at ~:8857; Remove-MoeWrapperPin at moe-agent.ps1:8418, before its loop at ~:8547. The `type -t` guard at moe-agent.sh:240 exists only because cleanup_temp's EXIT trap can fire before :8793 is parsed. A guard inside the loop would be dead code.
- A wrapper edit hot-reloads every seat and needs sh/ps1 parity plus the launcher harnesses. This test-only edit needs neither, and leaves task-69c02444's hunks untouched.
- The ps1 twin has the same gap. moe-agent.ps1:8592 calls Remove-MoeWrapperPin on the same MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT path, so the PowerShell case fails wherever pwsh exists: on CI's ubuntu-latest runner and on Windows. The WSL gate only skips it, because the env -i PATH has no pwsh. Stubbing only the bash side would leave CI red.

No runtime error handling is needed. The stubs mirror the real helpers' state reset (MOE_WRAPPER_PIN and $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin cleared) without their filesystem side effects.
implementationPlan.note: RED on pure HEAD snapshot: 'does not re-exec and lose a pending Bash sidecar handle' fails, 'bash: line 41: wrapper_pin_drop: command not found', code 127 (1 failed | 5 passed | 3 skipped). planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The test slices the reload body out of each wrapper by text anchors and runs it with every helper stubbed.
